subject: nineTailedKitsune
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: nine-tailed kitsune fox with spirit flames.
Style: high-fantasy anime.
reasoning:
Looking at the renders, the nine tails, ears, kumadori markings, and spirit flames all read well, but the head needs work—the eyes are too small and the muzzle looks flat and long, with the cheek ruffs appearing as flat grey shaded planes rather than textured fur.

The forehead fringe blades stick out as odd flat horizontal plates above the eyes instead of fur-like shapes; I should tilt their direction vector upward and back so they read as swept fringe rather than horns. The legs are also too thin and stilt-like with dark socks that make the body look spindly compared to the massive tail fan, so I'm thinking of scaling up the head and eyes slightly to balance proportions better against the oversized tails and flames.

Several floating hitodama flames and lanterns are overlapping the ears, nose, and muzzle in the three-quarter and head views, so I need to nudge their positions outward — moving the purple flame away from the ear and shifting the lanterns back in z so they don't collide with the fox's face from the camera's angle.

I'll move the offering stand to (-0.85, 0.85), clear of the legs. The tail sigil decals look fine though small, and I'll enlarge the ears slightly from 0.27 to 0.32 length for stronger identity, keeping the dark tips and flat grey cheek ruffs as is.

The cheek ruffs' orientation is making them read as thin dark fans from the front, but I'll just leave them fewer and better lit rather than fuss over the normal direction. Chest collar and ofuda are fine as hidden, the floating hitodama flames are intentional, and the plinth radius versus the top-view tail shadow looks proportionate.

I'm thickening the fore and hind leg radii slightly for sturdier stilts, bumping up the bean-shaped feet, and keeping the sock coverage as is. I'll also enlarge the body tube radii a bit to give better chest clearance while keeping the rump fluff intact.

Now I'm tweaking proportions further: scaling the skull up slightly, enlarging the eyes, bumping the forehead gem decal size, and widening the kumadori swoosh for better visibility. Then I'm preparing to locate the exact body sweep radii line in the code so I can make the precise edit.
